run_Pipeline_tools_get_current_time: run the Pipeline.Tools.get_current_time method to get the current time in EST
run_Pipeline_tools_get_all_lights: run the Pipeline.Tools.get_all_lights method to list all lights in the home
run_Pipeline_tools_control_light_on: run the Pipeline.Tools.control_light method to turn a light on by its friendly name
run_Pipeline_tools_control_light_off: run the Pipeline.Tools.control_light method to turn a light off by its friendly name
review_Pipeline_Valves: review the Pipeline.Valves class that configures HOME_ASSISTANT_URL and HOME_ASSISTANT_TOKEN
